'''Soren Talis''' was an agent who served in [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order|COMPNOR]], an agency of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="PH" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Perlemian Haul (adventure)|Perlemian Haul Adventure]], the Game Master can choose to have Talis travel with the [[Perlemian Haul]] Convoy.<ref name="PH" />
